actions.action: Compare both drafts against their shared revision
actions.mechanism: Three-way comparison separates independent edits from divergent changes without relying on edit timestamps.
actions.implementation: Retain the loaded baseline. After stale-save rejection, fetch the current revision; merge one-sided and identical changes, flagging divergent fields.
actions.check: Test a stale tab edited after the other tab saved: independent changes survive; divergent changes become conflicts.
actions.risk: Missing baselines must trigger explicit comparison, never guessed reconciliation.

actions.action: Resolve conflicting fields inside the current tab
actions.mechanism: Field-specific comparisons show relevant differences while leaving automatically combined fields out of the required resolution flow.
actions.implementation: Show labeled local, saved, and baseline values. Provide expandable text differences, an editable result, and explicit single-choice selection; retain originals.
actions.check: Resolve long-text and single-choice conflicts without switching windows, dragging, copying, or retyping independent edits.
actions.risk: Truncated previews can conceal differences; full values must remain accessible.

actions.action: Keep recoverable snapshots before resolving conflicts
actions.mechanism: Separate recovery history preserves both text versions even when users choose one or rewrite the result.
actions.implementation: Persist baseline, local text, fetched text, and resolution progress in per-tab recovery records before replacement; expose restore controls within the editor.
actions.check: Choose one version, reload, then restore the other text without another window; verify simultaneous tabs cannot overwrite recovery records.
actions.risk: Storage failure must block destructive replacement; retained text needs privacy safeguards.

actions.action: Recheck the revision when saving resolved drafts
actions.mechanism: Revision-conditional draft saves prevent another intervening save from invalidating the user's completed resolution.
actions.implementation: Submit the resolved draft against its compared revision. On rejection, preserve it and repeat comparison against the newest document; keep publishing separate.
actions.check: Inject another save during resolution: stale submission is rejected, new conflicts appear, and no publish request occurs.
actions.risk: Repeated intervening saves may require another resolution pass.
